status: builder integration specification; does not alter the source GLB

traceSampling.interpolation: periodic linear interpolation between angle-bin centers
traceSampling.widthPolicy: PBR/basecolor/normal/geometry envelope, clamped to 2-7 mm full width

requiredOrder: import the source GLB without changing transforms, materials, UVs, or normals
for each required/recommended seam, evaluate the three periodic non-planar contours on source triangles
deduplicate intersections per raw edge within each source UV/normal island; do not weld across attribute seams
split crossed faces at proximalBoundary, center, and distalBoundary in contour order, preserving winding and material index
interpolate position/UV/normal at every inserted loop vertex using the recorded edge alpha; renormalize normals
assign all chrome outside the two boundary loops rigidly; confine two-bone interpolation to the strip between them
validate rendered rest, flexion, and fist poses against the basecolor/normal dark gasket collars

weightSemantics.proximalBoundary: raw t=0 toward proximal rigid bone
weightSemantics.distalBoundary: raw t=1 toward distal rigid bone
weightSemantics.insideStrip: linear/geodesic raw t between contour loops; builder applies exactly one smoothstep

topologySemantics.G0Priority: subdivide all ten G0 collars before any weight-only build is accepted
topologySemantics.sourceVertexSidecar: continues to classify original positions; inserted contour vertices are generated deterministically from this spec
topologySemantics.attributePreservation: new loop attributes are edge-interpolated separately for every raw UV/normal seam copy
